title: Run the Glassroad
summary: Jett Marrows — undefeated* canyon racer — has publicly scheduled your humiliation: one run down the Glassroad, south gate to north, Slick Mile to the shrine. Ketch says take the race. The canyon's grip is slick and the line is everything.

objectives.label: Line up at the Glassroad's south gate
Run the canyon: Slick Mile → mid-span → glass chapel → north gate

offer.text: Attention, canyon! This is Jett Marrows, undefeated*, fastest thing on fused glass, and I've entered Varga in a race Varga hasn't agreed to yet. South gate. Sunrise. Be there or be a rumour.

Marrows has been calling out every courier under thirty for a decade. It's how he socialises. Take the race, kid — the Glassroad'll teach you more than I can, and it'll charge less for the lesson than the hospital would.

accept.text: She says yes! Listen up, Parcel: boost is wasted on the Slick Mile if you can't hold a line through the ripple. Braking distances down there are a *rumour*. Ask the chapel wall what the last rookie's bike looked like.

Race notes, from someone who built half the bikes on that canyon: ride the ripple like a handshake, boost off the glass not onto it, and never turn inside the shrine's shadow at dusk. It'll grab your skirt like a customs officer.
Copy both. Racing the canyon's loudest resident down the canyon's fastest scar. If I die, tell my debt it's free.

complete.text: …Okay. *Okay.* The drift out of the Slick Mile, that line through the chapel shadow — I'll allow it. Publicly. Once. The asterisk on my record is now doing a lot of work.
Real talk, Parcel: nobody's run that canyon at your split since Davenant. You want a rematch, you know the gate. You want my respect… you *also* know the gate.
Nice riding, kid. Flats and a following wind. Now keep the line tidy — the whole Driftline heard that split, and half of them just remembered who taught you.
